title: brief@v0
description: A brief predating front matter: every real brief@v0 in this repository's history is free-form Markdown prose with no --- front-matter block at all, so there is no structure left to validate. A file also reads as legacy when its front matter exists but carries no interlock key, or an interlock key that is not the string brief@v1. This schema accepts anything; interlock schema validate reports a brief@v0 file as legacy-valid without running it through here.
